A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we have shown that the transverse momentum distributions for the jet production at Collider energies, are consistent with the universality of the transverse momentum distribution observed in (e+e-) annihilation and DIS.
we have found no significant evidence for the presence of the new physics in the ISR data.

we have shown that the transverse properties of jets, measured at ISR energies, are consistent with a picture where the jet production mechanism is the same as in (e+e −) and DIS, and that the jet transverse momentum distribution at the Collider is consistent with a picture of a single parton in the jet.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the transverse properties of jets are universal, in that they can be described in terms of the same set of functions, independent of the hard scale.
the jet transverse momentum spectrum is not a good observable to study the transverse-momentum broadening of jets in a dense medium.
